Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing the application of barley straw to waters of the state.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to barley straw for water clarification; and addinga new section to chapter 90.48 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 90.48 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Notwithstanding any other provisions of this chapter, theapplication of barley straw to waters of the state for the purposes ofwater clarification does not require a state waste discharge permit aslong as the following provisions are met: (a) The barley straw is applied at a rate of up to two hundredtwentyfive pounds per acre of surface water; (b) Whole bales or tightly packed straw are not used. Straw mustbe loosely packed in nylon or mesh bags; (c) Bags of straw are placed where control is desired, such asaround docks and swim areas, and around inlets to aid in aeration ormixing; (d) The bags must be staked or anchored in place; (e) Straw is placed in early spring, prior to the growth of algae;and p. 1 SSB 6855 (f) Bags are removed four to six months after placement and mustnot be left in the water over winter. (2) The placement of barley straw into waters of the state in anyother instance is not authorized absent a permit. (3) This section does not alter any permit requirement that mayexist under chapter 77.55 RCW.
